svg.text: Choptuik echo period Δ(D) and critical exponent γ(D) of massless scalar collapse
Power series in 1/(D−2) fitted on D ≤ 25.5 (80 points); the 20 hollow points above D = 25.5 are held out and match it to 3e-07
Δ levels off at Δ∞ ≈ 1.6441 instead of falling to zero
power series in 1/(D−2), extended to D = 60
Against 1/(D−2), Δ runs into a finite intercept
Spectral multiple shooting with nonlinear elimination (solver/CONTEXT.md); hover a point for its value, a curve for its coefficients
